title: Recurring operator instruction bullets become reviewed standards records with stack scope
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114c #5 second PR. krn standards harvest --repos-file over 89 operator repositories (.krn/runs/lanes-1114c/harvest-out.txt, 275 lines) lists recurring instruction bullets; standards/records.json has 26 records and none for PHP, WordPress or frontend.
Outcome: candidates that are real engineering standards (not tracker or session boilerplate from a shared template, not Beads/bd workflow, which the operator retired) become records in standards/records.json with tier, scope (stack applicability) and enforcement where mechanically checkable; the rejected candidate groups are listed with a one-line reason in the PR body.
Proof: standards schema tests PASS; krn standards check --root . PASS; npm run fast PASS.
